The top row is spade, diamond, spade with sum 53. The middle row is diamond, spade, club with sum 47. The bottom row is diamond, club, spade with sum 47. The first column has spade, diamond, diamond with sum 52. The second column has diamond, spade, club with sum 47. The third column has spade, club, spade with sum 48. The second image asks for spade + diamond - club. Reasoning: Let spade = S, diamond = D, and club = C. From the top row, S + D + S = 53, so 2S + D = 53. From the first column, S + D + D = 52, so S + 2D = 52. Subtracting the second equation from the first gives S - D = 1, so S = D + 1. Substitute into S + 2D = 52: D + 1 + 2D = 52, so 3D = 51 and D = 17. Then S = 18. From the middle row, D + S + C = 47, so 17 + 18 + C = 47, giving C = 12. The requested value is S + D - C = 18 + 17 - 12 = 23.
